stem: Meena winds a coil of insulated copper wire around an iron nail and connects it to a cell to make an electromagnet. She brings the north pole of a small magnetic compass near end X of the nail, and the compass needle is attracted towards X. What does this show about the two ends of the electromagnet?

options.text: End X is a South pole and end Y is a North pole.
End X is a North pole and end Y is a South pole.
Both ends X and Y are North poles.
Both ends X and Y are South poles.

teacher.key_rationale: Unlike poles attract, so if the compass north pole is attracted to end X, X must be the South pole; the other end Y is therefore the North pole.
